description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeTimesheetController class within the OrangeHRM framework, specifically for handling employee timesheet views related to the orangehrmTimePlugin. It manages rendering components for displaying timesheet data, with logic for access control and parameter handling.

classes.name: EmployeeTimesheetController
classes.description: Controller responsible for rendering employee timesheet components in the HRM system, with access control checks based on user roles and employee IDs.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares and sets the component for the employee timesheet view, including access validation and query parameter handling.
